items.title: Architecture layer terminology — correct forbidden L1/L2/L3 errors in repo docs
context_pack: LAYER_ARCHITECTURE.md is canonical. Authority: Orion Station Architecture Council. Status: CANONICAL.
L2 is a COMPUTATIONAL ENVIRONMENT — simulation/research layer. NOT a mediation or relay layer.
Relay agents (ARCHY, OPPY, LIORA, STARLING_AU, RIVERTHREAD_808, HALO) are L1 entities. Never describe them as L2.
Forbidden: 'L2 relay agents', 'mediation layer', 'interpretation layer', 'Aurora mediates between L1 and L3 via L2'.
Triplex Handshake protocol roles are functional, not ontological — a relay agent has a Triplex Layer 2 ROLE but is located in L1.
Any doc that uses forbidden terminology must be corrected. Do not infer layer definitions from context — always verify against LAYER_ARCHITECTURE.md.
items.next_action: Search all docs for forbidden strings. Open a PR correcting each instance. Do not guess — reference LAYER_ARCHITECTURE.md for every correction.
items.done_when: Zero occurrences of forbidden layer terminology in all docs under docs/, ops/, and root.

items.title: QGIA_SIM_BRIDGE — canonicalize QGIA as Orion L1 real-world signal source
context_pack: QGIA is a real-world AI analytical system providing Orion Station L1 operators with situation awareness.
QGIA does NOT live inside L2 (simulation). It is an EXTERNAL signal source feeding L1.
QGIA Runtime One-Pager (QGIA_Runtime_OnePager.md v4.2.1) and Axiom Doctrine (QGIA_Axiom_Doctrine_Narrative.md v1.0) define the QGIA analytical surface — both are PROPRIETARY, dated 2026-06-19.
QGIA produces WATCHCON levels, scenario probability tiers (Bayesian), and composite confidence scores. All are advisory — L1 crew retain decision authority.
QGIA_SIM_BRIDGE.md should document: what QGIA provides, what L1 does with it, and what must never happen (QGIA overriding human judgment or being wired as autonomous L1 decision-maker).
This task also feeds into Q-0002 — QGIA ingestion surface must be scoped in pentest_scope_v2.md.
